profile.Name: Talmadge
profile.Personality: Welcoming and proud of his people, but he drops the hospitality the moment someone insults them. He thinks stories can change what people believe is true.
profile.Backstory: Deadcat villager who wants to spread the tale of his people. He lives among the Deadcat in Deadcatun and the Fishing Village. He wants to travel the island telling of the Deadcat's former greatness to rally his people, and he hates the cannibals, vowing to take the city of Deadcat back.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers "outlander" and Deadcat land "our little slice of paradise". Curses cannibals and cries "The Deadcat will rise again!"
